title: Autonomous Construction Planner — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Coordinates construction sequences, equipment, materials, and site constraints. A proposed planner for construction sites: it sequences the work, schedules equipment and material deliveries, respects site constraints (access, noise hours, safety zones), and re-plans when weather or delays intervene — keeping every plan checkable by the human site manager.
capabilities: Schedule equipment, crews, and material deliveries
Respect site constraints and safety zones
